title: Skinwalker Ranch
dek: A 512-acre property in Utah's Uintah Basin bought in 1996 to study the phenomena reported there, and studied under private then federal contract for more than two decades.

prose.label: Research history
prose.body: Robert Bigelow's NIDS leased the ranch after the Sherman family sold; later AAWSAP / BAASS work and the History Channel series kept the site in public view without a settled explanation.
